; 36 pointer-selected streams occupy this exact aggregate. Each begins with pixel X/Y, then two-byte movement records or opcode-specific one/two/three-byte commands. Opcode 0E contains a CPU callback target executed by the AD/EE trampoline; callbacks are separate code, not arbitrary pointers.

; 35 pairs of big-endian start/end event indices precede six-byte sound events. End indices are inclusive; all 1004 events tile the validated event extent through physical 6324. Channel/operation consumers determine each event field; this physical slice continues across the bank boundary.
